meta.title: 一体快挂+悬浮背负 COTTON 25L 摄影双肩包
meta.title_en: COTTON 25L Photo Backpack: Quick-Draw + Floating Back

scenes.context: 把相机转过来放进快装底座，手机轻松放进去，这是一个上锁状态。
sentences: Turn the camera and drop it in.
paraphrase: Turn the camera and drop it in.
scenes.speak: Turn the camera and drop it in. It locks into place automatically.

scenes.context: 外包装扁平，25升不是特别大的尺寸，但自家快装系统非常好用。
scenes.speak: 25 liters isn't a huge size. Its own quick-draw system shines.

scenes.context: 原生的原型快装底座，腰带比较软、没有硬型框架塑形，这个位置预留了快装位。
sentences: The hip belt is quite soft.
A quick-draw slot is reserved here.
paraphrase: The hip belt is quite soft.
A quick-draw slot is reserved here.
scenes.speak: The hip belt is quite soft. A quick-draw slot is reserved here.

scenes.context: 一边是防雨袋且内部是硬的，另一边是收缩的水袋或太阳眼镜袋，上标网格材质内里泡棉。
sentences: One side holds a stiff rain cover.
The other side is a mesh bottle pocket.
paraphrase: One side holds a stiff rain cover.
The other side is a mesh bottle pocket.
scenes.speak: One side holds a stiff rain cover. The other side is a mesh bottle pocket.

scenes.context: 背板是悬浮型的、里侧镂空，肩带可做背长调节，多个挡位适应不同背长。
sentences: The back panel floats off the pack.
Straps adjust to different torso lengths.
paraphrase: The back panel floats off the pack.
Straps adjust to different torso lengths.
scenes.speak: The back panel floats off the pack. Straps adjust to different torso lengths.

scenes.context: 内部有金属框架支撑，底部也有金属框架，下面还配有防雨罩。
scenes.speak: There's a metal frame inside. The bottom has support too.

scenes.context: 正面带鼠舱和网袋拓展，两边有挂点，可以挂登山杖或DIY头盔网练。
scenes.speak: The front has mesh expansion. Side lash points are versatile.

scenes.context: 悬浮背框让包体微微拗起，背负感和散热更好，缺点是网内侵占包体空间。
sentences: The downside: it eats into inner space.
paraphrase: The downside: it eats into inner space.
scenes.speak: The floating frame ventilates better. The downside: it eats into inner space.

practice: The back panel floats off the pack.
